hero.title: File:Russian Memorial, Lewes (IoE 292975).jpg
hero.description: Russian Memorial, St John sub Castro, Lewes, East Sussex, England. Obelisk in a neo-Gothic style erected in 1877 at behest of Tsar Alexander II in memory of Finnish soldiers of the Russian Army during the Crimean War who died as prisoners of war in Lewes. Listed at Grade II by English Heritage (IoE Code 292975)
categories: Freedom of panorama works possibly copyrighted in the U.S.
